notes.title: Разрушительный автопробег: Обзор Deliver At All Costs
notes.notes: Небольшие инди-команды продолжают неустанно искать новые идеи, стремясь выделиться в общем потоке контента. Так, шведская студия Far Out Games под крылом Konami решила обратиться за вдохновением к Grand Theft Auto, перенеся действо в мир диорам и сделав акцент на разрушаемости окружения и комедийной абсурдности.

notes.title: Deliver At All Costs: Launch
notes.notes:
[url=https://deliveratallcosts.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41822553/f351dca93c4d68035db574e4fd746ef8674c7d3f.gif[/img][/url]

[b]From our screens to yours.[/b]

We can hardly believe we’re writing this, but Deliver At All Costs is almost out in the world. As our debut title, this game means everything to us, and as we approach launch day, we wanted to take a moment to reflect, share a bit about what makes the game special.

One of the most rewarding parts of making Deliver At All Costs has been building this world from the ground up. We’ve poured our hearts into crafting an environment filled with purpose. Whether it’s a hidden encounter down an alleyway or a quiet story told through the setting itself, we wanted this game to feel alive. Watching it evolve from a scrappy idea into a world you can explore has been nothing short of magical.

When you play, our biggest hope is that you feel the variety we worked so hard to pack in. Each mission brings something new. Sometimes chaotic, sometimes quiet, always different. We want you to lose yourself in the immersive atmosphere. This is a full story with a beginning, middle, and end, but we promise, there are still mysteries waiting to be uncovered.

What sets Deliver At All Costs apart? For starters, everything is destructible. Yep, that crate? Gone. That wall? Smash it. That entire building? Boom. But it’s not just the physics that makes it special; it’s the 1950s-inspired setting, the era-defining soundtrack, and the narrative that pulls you in and doesn’t let go.

So what’s next for us at Studio Far Out Games? Hopefully, a bit of rest and then maybe some DLC… or even a sequel? We can’t say for sure yet. What we can say is that this is only the beginning. Our notebooks are full, our coffee’s hot, and our passion is stronger than ever.

Thank you for being part of this journey with us. We can’t wait for you to play Deliver At All Costs.

notes.title: Deliver At All Costs review
notes.notes:
They say that if you ignore your detractors, you also have to ignore the praise. But I'm proud that my boss told me I'm a good courier. "I am a good courier", I think, ramming a remote control corvette destined for a local child's chimney into a pedestrian's shins, knocking them skyward, zipping away before the sound of soft bones on hard concrete catches up with me. "The best courier," I nod, reversing my truck into a beach-front bar on the way to fumigate a truckful of rotting melons. "The best damn courier in town!", I exclaim, honking my newly-installed cursehorn, shattering nearby windows and streetlights into glinting injury confetti.

Sometimes, confidence is more valuable than a measured perspective on things, and if you need to focus on the praise to block out the little voice telling you the way you're driving to these sun-kissed surf guitars is less Dennis Wilson, more Charlie Manson, so be it. Deliver At All Costs has me thinking a lot about confidence, in fact. It invokes GTA with a linked series of open maps, constantly devil-whispering your attention away from main and side missions with the promise of the hallowed fuckaboutsesh - smashable suburbia detailed down to the individual fence picket taking the place of rocket launchers and car pile-ups. But tragically, it's also cursed with a lack of confidence that this is enough. It wants to be something more.

notes.title: Deliver At All Costs (PS5) Review
notes.notes:
Deliver At All Costs is definitely one of those games you could sell on concept alone. A chaotic courier simulator styled in a way that’s reminiscent of early Grand Theft Auto? Say no more! But as I’ve learned in the past, a game can’t exist on concept alone and the critical…well, delivery can make all the difference. 

Thankfully, Deliver At All Costs finds a way to not only present its premise in a unique and interesting way, but it continuously builds on top of it for a game that revels in chaos and is consistently having fun. In a lot of ways, it’s capturing the spirit of the original Grand Theft Auto, but in so many more ways, it feels like a proper parody of the form.

In Deliver At All Costs, players take on the role of Winston Green—a down on his luck tech wiz who might have a few screws loose. Without a dollar to his name, he looks for work at the local We Deliver delivery company, lucking upon a job as a courier for some…questionable assignments. Willing... Read more

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
With only [u]a week left[/u] until the release, we wanted to share some info about how Deliver At All Costs runs on the Steam Deck.

In our testing, the game performs very well—it’s a great fit for on-the-go action! That said, there are a few things to keep in mind:
[list]
[*][b]Performance:[/b] With default settings, you can expect around 50 FPS. It's possible to boost this to 60 FPS with a few tweaks (see below for details!).
[*][b]Text Size:[/b] Some UI elements, like dialogue boxes, may appear a bit small and can be hard to read on the Deck’s screen.
[*][b]Texture Quality:[/b] The highest texture quality is capped at medium due to memory limits. Thankfully, this isn’t really noticeable given the Deck’s smaller display resolution.
[/list]
Aside from those points, the experience is nearly identical to the PC version!

[h3]Want smoother performance? Try these settings:[/h3]
[i]Disclaimer: The settings described below [b]will not work on the Demo[/b] version of the game.[/i]

If you're aiming for a consistent 60 FPS and don’t mind a slight dip in image quality, we recommend you to try the following settings:
[list]
[*][b]Resolution:[/b] Set to 960x600 in the in-game graphics settings.
[*][b]Fullscreen:[/b] Turn off fullscreen mode (this is important for FSR to work!).
[*][b]Sharp Scaling:[/b] Enable Sharp scaling (FSR) in the Steam Deck's performance menu:

[olist]
[*]Press the three dots on the right side of the Steam Deck.
[*]Tap the lightning bolt icon to open the performance menu.
[*]Scroll down to Scaling Filter and set it to Sharp (previously called FSR).
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41822553/ded787c3391f7cf5c3027be21eaa9d84fe40f988.png[/img][/list]
See you on May 22nd!

notes.title: Deliver At All Costs: Behind the Music & Voices
notes.notes:
[url=https://deliveratallcosts.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41822553/f351dca93c4d68035db574e4fd746ef8674c7d3f.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Behind the Music & Voices

A Love Letter to 1950s Sound[/b]

From the very beginning, we understood that music and voice talent would be central to Deliver At All Costs’ identity. Set in a stylized world inspired by the 1950s and ’60s, we fully embraced the rich atmosphere of the era—and it shows.

Leading the charge on the soundtrack is acclaimed composer Patrik Jarlestam, known for his work on Valheim. Featuring about 80 minutes of original music, the score is not only extensive but also meticulously crafted, primarily using real instruments to achieve that warm, analog sound of mid-century America. From lively rock ’ n ’ roll rhythms to cinematic noir undertones, every track radiates period-authentic vibes.

But the audio excellence doesn’t end with the music. The entire manuscript is fully voice-acted, bringing characters and their quirks to life in vivid detail. With a cast of around 50 voice actors, the scope of the voice work is vast. We have invested so much love into casting and directing a diverse range of performances, enhancing both storytelling and immersion.

Whether you're drawn in by the gameplay, the aesthetic, or simply here to enjoy the tunes, Deliver At All Costs promises an audio experience as unforgettable as its chaotic delivery runs.

notes.title: Deliver At All Costs: Vehicles & Locations
notes.notes:
[url=https://deliveratallcosts.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41822553/f351dca93c4d68035db574e4fd746ef8674c7d3f.gif[/img][/url]

[b]What to drive and where to drive it.

Get to know the vast vehicles and lively locations of Deliver At All Costs![/b]

One of our biggest passions (and challenges) has been crafting the main player car, the Company Car. This isn’t just any vehicle; it’s one of the main characters! We’ve put a tremendous amount of effort into designing how it moves, how it takes damage, and how its gadgets fit into the game’s retro-futuristic aesthetic. Every dent, every shattered piece, and every high-tech modification has been carefully considered to ensure the perfect balance between function and flair. All of that was before we began working on the thirty or so other vehicles…

Beyond just the cars, we’ve been dedicated to creating a world that evokes the atmosphere and nostalgia of 1950s Americana. From neon-lit drive-in movie theaters to sketchy greaser hangouts, every environment is designed to transport players to a different time. Our research led us to some of the most iconic designs of the era. Those sweeping tailfins, chrome accents, and bold color choices defined the aesthetic of mid-century America.

Deliver At All Costs’ story unfolds across three acts, each featuring 5-8 smaller worlds, or "dioramas." Every diorama has a distinct theme, offering players a unique setting and gameplay experience. Whether it’s navigating the bustling streets of midtown, skidding through a treacherous harbor, racing along the lively boardwalk, or even exploring a volcano, each location adds a layer of personality to the game. We wanted every space to feel like a handcrafted, self-contained slice of this stylized world, keeping exploration fresh and immersive.

We can’t wait for players to get behind the wheel and experience it all firsthand!

notes.title: Delivering At All Costs: Missions
notes.notes:
[url=https://deliveratallcosts.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41822553/f351dca93c4d68035db574e4fd746ef8674c7d3f.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Mission Madness in Deliver At All Costs

Every mission is unique.[/b]

While developing Deliver At All Costs, we felt that every mission should feel like a brand-new adventure. Each mission is built around a different gameplay mechanic. Whether you're carefully plotting a route or embracing absolute chaos, the craziness ramps up with every delivery!

For example, in ACT 2, things really explode—literally. You'll find yourself delivering a rolling bomb shelter that wreaks havoc across the city as it barrels toward its destination. It's destruction meets delivery, and it's one of our proudest creations. Designing this variety has been our most ambitious (and challenging) undertaking, but we think you’ll love every moment.

It’s not just the missions, though. The encounters you’ll find as Winston explores St Monique are just as unique. Take Bubbles, the mischievous clown at the Fun Fair. He’s got one goal for you: drive a haunted car straight to top of mountain. Yes, you read that right.

And let’s not forget the hidden treasures waiting for discovery! Deliver At All Costs is packed with a dozen secret vehicles and bizarre gadgets—upgrades to your main ride that grant outrageous abilities, like a jet engine strapped to your delivery truck. These gadgets can turn the tide of any mission and add a whole new layer of mayhem.

We can’t wait for you to experience the madness we’ve poured into this game. Each mission is a love letter to creativity and chaos, and we’re so excited to see how you tackle them.

notes.title: Delivering At All Costs: Story and Setting
notes.notes:
[url=https://deliveratallcosts.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41822553/f351dca93c4d68035db574e4fd746ef8674c7d3f.gif[/img][/url]

[b]We crafted Deliver At All Costs’ story to provide a journey just as chaotic as the gameplay![/b]

At the centre of Deliver At All Costs is our protagonist: Winston Green, a down-on-his-luck courier with a fiery temper. His story begins with his first day on the job, but as his circumstances unravel, he is thrown into a downward spiral that explores themes of desperation and madness.

Told in three acts, the narrative mirrors Winston’s journey, starting in a world bathed in bright, sunlit optimism and shifting towards shadows and turmoil. With over 30,000 meticulously crafted words and two hours of fully voice-acted cinematics, Deliver At All Costs invites players to immerse themselves in a deeply mysterious, cinematic experience. For those who love to piece together mysteries, we’ve sprinkled some hidden clues throughout the game that hint at larger themes.

The first act of Deliver At All Costs introduces you to the island of St Monique, a fictional location inspired by the vibrant aesthetics and culture of Key West, Miami, and Santa Monica. But St Monique isn’t just a backdrop, it’s a character in its own right. As you explore, you’ll encounter the culture, music, and wacky characters of the era. Whether you’re cruising along the coast, navigating the bustling downtown streets, or slaloming through industrial zones, every inch of St Monique has a story to tell.

St Monique is just the beginning. This is only one of three cities you’ll get to explore throughout the game. Each location offers its own distinct atmosphere, characters, and challenges, ensuring that no two areas look or feel the same.

Take a glance at the chaotic and mysterious journey that Deliver At All Costs will deliver. The next episode of Delivering At All Costs, our dev diary series, is live!

notes.title: Delivering At All Costs: Destruction and Retaliation
notes.notes:
[url=https://deliveratallcosts.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41822553/f351dca93c4d68035db574e4fd746ef8674c7d3f.gif[/img][/url]

Everything is destructible.

It takes up to two hours to set up a building for destruction, but it’ll take mere seconds to tear one down!

When we began the project, we had a bold mantra: ‘Everything is destructible.’ It sounded ambitious, almost reckless, and boy, did it give us some sleepless nights.

In Deliver At All Costs, destruction isn’t just a gimmick - it’s the heartbeat of the entire experience. Every building, car, tree, and power line is part of our living, breakable world. Each structure is meticulously designed to collapse into 50-100 individually breakable parts. Smashing through a wall or levelling a tower is pure catharsis. But it’s not just scenery — your decisions have consequences. Destroy the wrong building, and you might block your path to a critical side mission. (Don’t worry, your actions won’t affect the main story!)

The vehicles, especially your trusty We Deliver pick-up, are no exception to this destruction-fueled mayhem. With 36 breakable pieces, your car’s appearance and functionality evolve (or devolve) as you take damage. Lose your hatch? You better start delivering melons in reverse. It’s not just about looking cool — every dent, dangling door, and burst gas tank can impact gameplay, creating hilarious and challenging moments.

Civilians add another layer of chaos. They’re not just helpless bystanders — they fight back. A chainsaw-wielding pedestrian might rip off a door, or a daring sledgehammer jump could cut your commute short.

Want to learn about the process behind Deliver At All Costs’ immense destruction? The next episode of Delivering At All Costs, our dev diary series, is live!

[previewyoutube=lB6Up_jQ5Kk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Deliver At All Costs: The Team Behind the Game
notes.notes:
[b]From students to storytellers. Meet Far Out Games, the team willing to deliver the destruction! [/b]

Picture this: The beautiful city of Gothenburg, Sweden, and a dev team on the cusp of greatness! 

You’ve most likely seen the chaos and you’ve probably heard about the gripping narrative. But we want to tell you about the passion, the vision, and the journey behind our game. 

We set sail to turn a school project into our dream project. This decision took our four founders - Lars, Daniel, Jimmy, and Jonatan - to several key moments. This included pitching Deliver At All Costs, winning awards, striking a publishing deal with KONAMI, and most importantly, maturing as a team. 

The chaos and charisma we poured into Deliver At All Costs became public knowledge thanks to an article by PC Gamer. This sparked interest in the game from various publishers. With great things in the headlights, it was time for Far Out Games to be born. We built a team consisting of twelve alumni from game development programs in Sweden with incredibly varied backgrounds. 

Want to see the team in action and get to know us a little more? The first episode of Delivering Deliver At All Costs, our dev diary series, is now live!

notes.title: Deliver At All Costs - Announcement
notes.notes:
[h3][/h3][h3][b]It's official! We’re excited to announce that our 1950s-inspired indie action-adventure game, Deliver At All Costs, is being published by KONAMI![/b][/h3]

We’re excited to invite you into the world we have created, where rock ‘n’ roll reigns supreme, polka dots are in peak fashion, and the fear of nuclear apocalypse looms. So, get ready to experience a dynamic era piece packed with intrigue and a whole lot of destruction!

You’ll be stepping into the shoes of Winston Green, a hot-tempered courier with a shady past. As Winston, you’ll undertake bizarre and perilous deliveries that will push you to your limits. You can weave through destructible environments using an array of vehicles, or stick with your company-issued We Deliver pick-up. 

Deliver At All Costs truly captures the essence of the 1950’s, blending iconic design, music, and the raw energy of the time into every aspect of the game. Whether you're careening through the streets to an inspired soundtrack or unravelling the secrets that drive the story, the game promises an experience that is as thrilling as it is nostalgic.

We’re working hard with KONAMI to bring Deliver At All Costs to life on both PC and consoles. In fact, you can wishlist it right here on Steam, which is always massively appreciated!

notes.title: Deeply destructive driving game Deliver At All Costs will see you smashing 1950s America to pieces
notes.notes:
It is 1959. The cold war is in full swing, television is taking over, and environments have just become fully destructible. What a time to be alive. Deliver At All Costs is a chaotic courier sim set in those heady days that sees the player barrelling around a "semi-open" US town as they take on absurd odd jobs. "From delivering a giant flailing Marlin, to the disposal of an atomic bomb teetering on the edge of explosion," say the developers, "always expect the unexpected." It's maybe best understood by witnessing the moment in the trailer below where the player drifts right through a menswear store, bringing the whole building down. Yep, that looks like a good time.

Read more
